message: The other day, I realized I still had a half-eaten box of crackers from last summer’s storm prep in my pantry. At least they were still edible — not exactly gourmet, but it’s great to know I can still snack my way through a power outage if needed. Maybe it’s time to give my emergency supplies a little refresh, or at least toss the old snacks. Anyone else find a surprise stash in their own 'prep' corner?
